native_early_return.later_failure: report initialized fields only with safely established measurements; missing coords null, unknown counts/bytes zero; work_used successfully reserved total

native_early_return.nonnull_report: initialize every field first: status=ARGUMENT, phase=arguments, detail=null-argument, all optional coordinates UINT32_MAX, all counts/bytes/work/flags zero
native_early_return.normal_start: precharge actual sizeof Workspace before clearing, then safe header copy precharged by actual sizeof; fixed report initialization/return writes are bounded constant overhead, not native work units
native_early_return.null_report: return ARGUMENT immediately; no report/workspace/root read or write
native_early_return.other_null_argument: check root, expected, workspace in that order; return ARGUMENT with field coordinate 0,1,2 respectively; workspace untouched and work_used=0

native_work_costs.counter_failure: atomic no counter change, no operation
